name: El Paso, Texas 1908
source: University of Texas Libraries GeoData, 43 georeferenced sheets (utlmaps_<uuid>.tif)
notes: Near-neutral paper, so fills are found by saturation alone and the hue route stays off. All five materials appear; adobe is common in El Paso but is also the least reliable class, since it is a neutral wash. The skipped sheet is an oversized non-map plate. Sheets overlap heavily, so deduplication matters here.
